lesson_title: Alive, Once Alive or Never Alive
hook_text: A shell, a crab and a plastic bottle wash up on a Durban beach. Only one of them is alive right now.
clip_script: Beach clean-up in Durban! A crab scuttles away. Alive! It feeds, grows, breathes, senses and moves. A shell. Not alive now, but it was part of a sea animal. Once living! Driftwood? Once a tree. Once living! Sand, a rock, a plastic bottle? Never alive. And the fire on the braai? It moves and grows, but it cannot do all seven. Not alive. Three baskets: living, once living, never living. Which basket for your school shoes?
visual_style: Whiteboard beach with three labelled baskets: living, once living, never living; objects fly into the right basket.
mood: Bright and brisk, like a beach clean-up race.
pacing: Quick sorting, a pause on the tricky shell and fire, then the seven-process test.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and sort ten things in your bedroom into the three baskets.
